verdict.rationale: Vanta ships AI features (Vanta AI Agent, AI evidence review, MCP server), so a no-training or opt-out guarantee for customer data is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for AI models. The GDPR and privacy-workflow mentions concern customers' own compliance programs, not Vanta's handling of customer data for model training.
